resolved_conflicts.explanation: Kemnow's site places the lookout on the Teton National Forest. The Wikipedia Mount Hancock article places a peak on the ridge in Yellowstone National Park and describes the ridge as on the park's southern border. The story reports both and does not decide. The record's agency field is left as Teton National Forest.
Kemnow's site presents Big Game Ridge as a forest lookout. The association lists the site as unknown or undocumented and moves sites to its lookout lists when evidence of regular use turns up.

notes_for_editor: No source describes a build date, design, staffing, use, removal, or the site's condition today. The only lookout claim is Kemnow's listing with the forest and county. The FFLA lists the site as undocumented with no coordinates. The agency conflict is unresolved: Kemnow says Teton National Forest, while Wikipedia says Yellowstone National Park. Wikipedia is a lead only; its own citations were not traced, and a person should check the Yellowstone and forest boundary before publishing. The record's coordinates (44.1322, -110.3767) were not checked against any source. Wikipedia's Mount Hancock coordinates (44 09 19 N, 110 25 03 W) lie roughly 4 km from the record's point, by a rough calculation, so the point may sit near the park boundary; this was not verified.
